method: Deterministic original vertex-normal inward rays from corresponding v13/v14 exterior points. Original external-distance<0.2mm; z>50; start farther than1.25mm from cut plane. Accept opposing wall within8mm, exclude exits within0.6mm of seam as seam chords. Ordinary and within9mm of actual internal hardware reported separately.
limitations: Finite directional samples, not a continuous minimum-wall certificate; missing/seam-exit rays are retained as counts and never treated as wall thickness. Independent complete assembly and intersection checks are separate.
